comparison_rule: complete-case, repetition-1, and available-trial rows differ in participants/observations and are non-comparable before/after model improvements
evidence_promotion: no consumed cohort is promoted to confirmation
model_protocol: all inherited classical/invention and neural controls; unchanged model/hyperparameter budgets
prior_complete_case_run: retained unchanged as a separate prespecified 19-participant analysis

selection_policy.invalid_trial: quarantine affected trial for missing sensor schema, annotation conflict, or no finite complete window; do not drop valid peer trials
selection_policy.missing_classes: retain and report fixed-class ceiling, present-class and complete-class sensitivities
selection_policy.missing_trial: record missing file; retain other available trials and do not invent data
selection_policy.participant_eligibility: at least one eligible window from an available valid trial
selection_policy.requested_participants: all provider participants; no outcome-based selection

signal_pipeline: same file-defined trial boundaries, finite runs, units, causal 0.30 Hz gravity, 60-to-50 Hz resampling and 128/128 windows as frozen external v3; missingness changes eligibility only
statistical_rule: same seed-averaged participant fixed-class metric and 10000 participant-cluster bootstrap; descriptive sensitivity only, no additional primary superiority hypothesis
stop_rule: one full three-seed suite and transfer after clean implementation/protocol commit; preserve all failures and exclusions
transfer: same source-only transfer suite into corrected FoG; development evidence
